welcome: Ask about your food, recipes or training, or tell me what to log.
listening: Listening… let go to finish, slide away to cancel.
toolsUnsupported: This model can't use tools: it can't read or change your data.
toolsRouted: One of the models behind this name can't use tools; this answer came without your data.
notSetUp: The assistant is on but has no model yet: add an API key or an endpoint.

speech.unsupported: This browser doesn't support voice input.
speech.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser's settings.
speech.insecure: Voice input needs a secure (https) connection.

errors.missingKey: No API key. Add one under Settings > Trace AI assistant.
errors.missingBaseUrl: The OpenAI-compatible provider needs a base URL (Settings > Trace AI assistant).
errors.missingModel: The OpenAI-compatible provider needs a model name (Settings > Trace AI assistant).
errors.tooManyRounds: The assistant used too many steps. Try a narrower question.
errors.unreachable: No answer from {{host}}. Is it reachable, and does it allow {{origin}} to read its answers (CORS)?
errors.unreachableInsecure: {{host}} uses http; a page on https can't call it. Use an https address.
errors.unreachableOfficial: No answer from {{host}}. Check your connection and any blocker.
